headline: Vitol invokes $10m bank guarantee against EKI Energy
summary: Vitol Asia invoked a $10 million bank guarantee from EKI Energy Services after alleging default. EKI disputes the claim and plans legal action, citing strong equity of ₹418.93 crore.

headline: Fratelli Vineyards Q2FY27 Results
summary: Fratelli Vineyards reported a consolidated net loss of ₹477.19 lakh in Q2FY27, widening from the prior year. The board approved financial results and appointed Avinash Gautam Thadani as an Independent Director.

headline: Shelter Pharma H1FY27: PAT up 15.4% to ₹5.2 crore
summary: Shelter Pharma reported a 35.6% YoY revenue jump to ₹45.1 crore in H1FY27. Net profit rose 15.4% to ₹5.2 crore, driven by strong human health and export growth.

headline: HD Fire Protect gets GST notice dropped for FY23
summary: HD Fire Protect Limited received an order dropping GST proceedings for FY23. The demand of ₹7.10 crore was fully waived with nil liability.

headline: Chowgule Steamships posts Q2FY27 loss
summary: Chowgule Steamships reported a net loss of ₹20.84 lakh in Q2FY27, reversing from a profit of ₹15.56 lakh in the year-ago quarter. Total income fell to ₹110.39 lakh.

headline: Sammaan Capital clears NCD dues on time
summary: Sammaan Capital Limited certified timely payment of principal and interest on secured redeemable NCDs due November 9, 2026. The company settled all scheduled obligations across multiple series.

headline: Baroda Rayon gets ITAT relief, tax addition deleted
summary: ITAT Mumbai allowed Baroda Rayon's appeals for AY 2014-15, deleting ₹12.15 crore tax addition and ₹4.13 crore penalty under Section 68 and 271(1)(c).

headline: Wardwizard posts Q2FY27 loss of ₹581.53 lakh
summary: Wardwizard Innovations & Mobility reported a net loss of ₹581.53 lakh in Q2FY27 as revenue fell 74% YoY. The board also appointed Vishal Shah as an independent director.

headline: Brooks Labs posts ₹70 crore Q2FY27 profit on stake sale
summary: Brooks Laboratories reported a net profit of ₹69.99 crore for Q2FY27, driven by a ₹74.70 crore exceptional gain from divesting its stake in Brooks Steriscience.

headline: Sai Urja board meeting rescheduled to Nov 14
summary: Sai Urja Indo Ventures reschedules its board meeting to November 14, 2026, for Q2FY27 results. The original date was November 7, 2026.

headline: Yug Decor posts H1FY27 loss of ₹27.54 lakh
summary: Yug Decor Limited reported a net loss of ₹27.54 lakh for the half year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue rose to ₹2,138.14 lakh, but costs outpaced growth.

headline: K&R Rail Engineering ED resigns citing unexplainable reasons
summary: Sukesh Kumar Sharma resigned as Executive Director and KMP of K&R Rail Engineering Ltd effective November 6, 2026. The resignation was filed with BSE under SEBI regulations.

headline: Prime Focus passes EGM resolutions on Brahma AI
summary: Prime Focus Limited passed all resolutions at its EGM held on November 7, 2026. Key approvals included cessation of control over Brahma AI Holdings and related party transactions.

headline: Umiya Tubes promoters seek reclassification to public
summary: Umiya Tubes Limited received requests from multiple promoter group members to reclassify as public shareholders under SEBI Regulation 31A, citing nil or low holdings and lack of control.

headline: Prime Focus to host investor meet on Nov 16
summary: Prime Focus Limited will participate in the Avendus Spark INDX 2026 conference in Mumbai on November 16, 2026. The company confirmed no price-sensitive information will be shared.

headline: Mehul Colours H1FY27 Results: PAT falls 52% YoY
summary: Mehul Colours Limited reported a 52% YoY decline in net profit for H1FY27. Revenue rose 19.6% to ₹1,699.64 lakh, but margins contracted significantly.

headline: Umiya Tubes passes key resolutions via postal ballot
summary: Umiya Tubes Ltd shareholders approved name alteration and capital increase. All votes cast were in favour, with 100% support from participating public shareholders.

headline: Accuracy Shipping Q2FY27 results out
summary: Accuracy Shipping Ltd reported a standalone net profit of ₹3.39 million for Q2FY27, down 58% YoY. Consolidated PAT rose 84% to ₹11.01 million.

headline: South Indian Bank to host investor meet Nov 18
summary: South Indian Bank will participate in the Avendus Spark INDX Annual Investor Conference on November 18, 2026. The event features group and one-on-one meetings in Mumbai with no presentations planned.

headline: Dynamatic to host investor meet Nov 19
summary: Dynamatic Technologies will hold a physical investor and analyst meeting on November 19, 2026, in Bengaluru. The event aims to showcase company facilities.

headline: SEAMEC wins $26.14 million ONGC subsea contract
summary: SEAMEC secures a $26.14 million contract from Larsen & Toubro for subsea installation work on ONGC's PRP-X project, with completion expected by May 2027.

headline: Neogen Chemicals discloses insider share sale
summary: Neogen Chemicals Ltd disclosed the sale of 2,361 equity shares by Sanjay Natwarlal Mehta HUF on November 5-6, 2026. The transaction represents 0.01% of paid-up capital.

headline: Jay Ambe Supermarkets H1FY27 Results
summary: Jay Ambe Supermarkets reported H1FY27 standalone net profit of ₹1.91 crore, up 26% YoY. Revenue rose 30% to ₹39.81 crore.

headline: Gujarat Alkalies uploads Sep 2026 investor presentation
summary: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited uploaded an updated investor presentation for September 2026 on its website. The filing was made to BSE and NSE on November 7, 2026.

headline: Sharma East India Q2FY27: Profit dips 17% YoY
summary: Sharma East India Hospitals reported a 17.4% YoY decline in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹26.24 lakh despite 10% revenue growth, driven by higher finance costs.

headline: Market Creators Q2FY27 Results: Profit Turns Positive
summary: Market Creators Ltd posted a net profit of ₹11.83 lakh in Q2FY27, swinging from a loss of ₹23.96 lakh in Q2FY25. Revenue from operations rose 19% YoY to ₹143.12 lakh.

headline: Transglobe Foods Q2FY27: Turns profitable
summary: Transglobe Foods reported a net profit of ₹2.62 lakh in Q2FY27, reversing a loss from the previous quarter. However, accumulated losses of ₹88.36 lakh raise going concern doubts.

headline: Emerald Finance Q2FY27 PAT up 47% to ₹5.30 crore
summary: Emerald Finance reported a 45.81% YoY rise in total income to ₹10.07 crore and 47.14% growth in PAT for Q2FY27, driven by EWA platform expansion.

headline: Generic Engg AGM to approve ₹480 crore RPTs
summary: Generic Engineering Construction & Projects Ltd will hold its 32nd AGM on November 30, 2026, to adopt FY26 financials and ratify material related party transactions worth up to ₹480 crore.

headline: Ecofinity Atomix Q2FY27 Results
summary: Ecofinity Atomix Ltd reported standalone net profit of ₹63.62 lakh for Q2FY27, up 19% YoY. Revenue from operations surged 215% YoY to ₹2,102.01 lakh.

headline: Brandbucket Media posts FY25 loss, faces trading suspension
summary: Brandbucket Media & Technology reported a net loss of ₹8.86 lakh in FY25 as revenue fell 51%. The company faces trading suspension on BSE SME due to non-compliance and a ₹6.09 crore GST penalty.

headline: Velox Shipping cites small-cap exemption for RPT disclosures
summary: Velox Shipping and Logistics Limited informed BSE that related party transaction disclosures are not applicable for H1FY26 due to paid-up capital and net worth falling below SEBI LODR thresholds.

headline: Velox Shipping reports fund utilization deviation
summary: Velox Shipping and Logistics Limited disclosed a partial deviation in the utilization of ₹7.62 crore raised via preferential allotment, redirecting funds toward foreign acquisitions.
